name: Rib Eye Steak with Sautéed Mixed Vegetables
instructions: Wash green beans, carrots, and bell peppers.
Trim green bean ends and transfer to a large bowl. Seed and slice peppers into strips lengthwise; add to bowl. Trim ends, peel, and thinly slice carrots on the diagonal; add to bowl.
Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Season steak with salt and pepper on both sides.
Coat grill or skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Heat a separate skillet over medium heat.
Melt oil in skillet and add garlic; cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add vegetables and cook, stirring often, until tender-crisp, 5-6 minutes. Season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Serve steak with sautéed vegetables on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
